opts.title: Chazhma and the Glomar Explorer
lines: CHAZHMA: "We are on our way home and heard your fog horn. {{What are you doing here?}}"
HGE: "We are conducting ocean mining tests—deep-ocean mining tests."
CHAZHMA: "How much time will you be here?"
HGE: "We expect to finish testing in two to three weeks."
CHAZHMA: "{{I wish you all the best.}}"
opts.source: SOURCE: CIA, "PROJECT AZORIAN: THE STORY OF THE HUGHES GLOMAR EXPLORER" (STUDIES IN INTELLIGENCE, 1985; RELEASED 2010) · EXCERPTS, RECREATED
